'''Rod Latham EJP Maelstrom Variant''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls102.htm EJP Maelstrom Variant], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055904/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls102.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
